issue.title: The acceptance run of the hand-made motion runbook
issue.body:
## Parent

#12. Spec: `spec/12-contact-sheet-and-runbook.md` (success criteria 5 and 6).

## What to build

The acceptance run of the runbook. It adds no code.

- A new Claude session gets only the path of `docs/hand-made-motion.md` and a motion of one or two sentences from the owner.
- The session does not read the scratch folder of the sword flourish test.
- It makes the motion with `rsps.contact_sheet` and a copy of `docs/research/sword-flourish-test/flourish.py`.
- The owner reviews at most three videos.

The owner starts a Blender with the extension and the Blender MCP before the session.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The owner accepts the review video within three reviews, or the run fails.
- [ ] Issue 12 has a comment with the result: the motion asked for, the verdict, the number of reviews, each place where the runbook or the reference script was wrong or silent, and each tooling problem.
- [ ] No .blend, render or contact sheet is committed, and the comment holds no local path.

## Verification

The owner's verdict on the review video. Then:

```bash
gh issue view 12 --repo julian-perge/blender-addon-rs317-667mqo-makeup --json comments --jq '.comments[-1].body'
```
